names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Δεκεμβρίου, «Αγία Βασίλα», with the rank word left off. The distich on the same page spells the name with a double lambda, «Μάρτυς Βασίλλα», which is recorded here and not stored as a second form.

Read out of the body of the Охридски пролог’s first entry for 24. децембар ст. ст., «Тако преведе у веру и неку красну девицу Василију», in the nominative the same sentence’s sequel gives, «Ускоро Василија би посечена за Христа». The heading does not print the name; the body does, and the heading’s own «и други с њом» is what sends the reader to it. Measured before it was written and it has no other holder in the corpus.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Αγία Βασίλα»

attestations.note: The life page `/3223/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and is unusually careful about what it does and does not know. What the synaxaristes note of her is only this: «ότι συμμαρτύρησε με την Αγία Ευγενία (βλέπε ίδια ημέρα) και θανατώθηκε δια αποκεφαλισμού». Everything else the page gives as a named scholar's opinion, and **the two opinions do not agree**. S. Eustratiades thinks she is Eugenia's mother, because her memory stands with that of Eugenia's father Philip and of the servants Protas and Hyacinth, «που όλοι μαζί μαρτύρησαν στην Ρώμη επί Κομόδου (180 - 192 μ.Χ.)». Galanos, in the «Βίους των Αγίων», has Eugenia draw Basilla to Christianity at Rome, and Basilla's own betrothed Pompeius, an idolater, denounce both women — Basilla beheaded, Eugenia first thrown into the Tiber, saved out of it and beheaded after. **No `dates` object is drafted.** The years 180 to 192 belong to the grouping Eustratiades argues from, and the same site's page for Eugenia puts her in the second half of the third century; the two cannot both stand and this is not a reader's to settle. The only `related` row is to Eugenia, which both readings share. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 06.01.2026 (24. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобна мученица Евгенија и други с њом.“

attestations.note: WHY A ROW OFF A HEADING THAT DOES NOT PRINT THIS NAME. The heading is „Преподобна мученица Евгенија и други с њом.“ — Eugenia AND OTHERS WITH HER — and the body says who the others are. That is the 12-21 reader’s case exactly: there the heading’s «и шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом» was filled in by the body and the two companies took rows off that one heading, and here the clause is indefinite and the body names its members instead of counting them. It is NOT the 12-19 «Аглаида» refusal, where the heading named one man and carried no company clause at all and a name inside the body was therefore not a heading. The three the body names as beheaded in Rome about her death — «Ускоро Василија би посечена за Христа», and «Тада бише посечени и оба она евнуха, Прот и Јакинт» — are the «други с њом», and they are three folders this corpus already holds on this same menologion day in the Greek. AND ONE MORE NAME IN THE BODY TOOK NO ROW, WHICH IS THIS DAY’S OPEN QUESTION: `philip-father-of-eugenia`, her father, the eparch of all Egypt, who was baptised with his whole house at her trial, was chosen bishop of Alexandria and was then killed secretly by a wicked voivode named Теренције whom the Roman emperor sent for that purpose. He is named and he dies for the faith — but he dies in Alexandria and before she goes to Rome, so «с њом» does not reach him, and a reader does not stretch a heading. HE IS LEFT WITHOUT A SERBIAN ROW ON PURPOSE and named in the report; granting it is one line for the author. NO YEAR WAS WRITTEN ON THIS FOLDER. The entry’s one year, «25. децембра 262. године», is attached to Eugenia’s own beheading; that this person died about the same time is the narrative’s order and not a year the page states here, which is the 12-21 reader’s refusal to write 304 onto the two Nicomedia companies. The folder keeps the `dates` it had. `types` untouched — the heading’s «мученица» is the `martyr` the folder carries, and «Преподобна» belongs to Eugenia, who was a nun, and not to this person. The `related` rows to `eugenia` already stand in both directions and nothing was added. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).
